plugin.name: LLM
plugin.description: Calls an OpenAI-compatible LLM (OpenAI, LM Studio, Ollama) and stores the response in a SceneFlow variable.

optional.name: base_url
optional.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Use http://localhost:1234/v1/ for LM Studio.

optional.name: api_key
optional.description: API key (Bearer token). Leave empty for local servers that don't require auth.

optional.name: model
optional.description: Model ID to use. Leave empty or set to 'auto' to auto-select the first model reported by the server. Use 'gpt-4o-mini' for OpenAI, or the local model path for LM Studio / Ollama.

commands.name: send
commands.summary: Send a prompt to the LLM and store the response in a SceneFlow variable.
commands.description: Calls the configured LLM endpoint asynchronously. The SceneFlow should poll the responseVar with a CEdge loop (TEdge 1000ms + CEdge responseVar != '') to wait for the result. Both prompt and system support {varName} interpolation — placeholders like {patient_name} are replaced with the current SceneFlow variable value at call time.

params.name: system
params.description: System message (model persona / instructions). Supports {varName} placeholders.

params.name: responseVar
params.description: Name of the SceneFlow String variable to write the response into.

writes.description: Default response variable if responseVar is not specified in the action.
